title: Route all records/ readers to the athena/records worktree
summary: Define the records worktree path once in athena-data paths.rs beside repo_state_dir; add load_current forms to Records::load and RecordSet::load and move the live readers to them, falling back to in-tree records/ only when the worktree is absent. The site generator reads studies/, so it stays unchanged and is shown to still build identically. Audience: Athena operators and the verifier.

defaults_applied.how: All changes and tests are Rust.
Tests plus clean fmt and clippy are required.
Criteria compare reader outputs from worktree vs in-tree records.
A scan test enforces the single-path rule.
One path definition and load_current forms rather than per-caller patches.
Status and forecast must work on a checkout without records/.
Decisions and changelog document the move for outside readers.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The user's reply governs: site generator untouched, scan targets only real readers, and the scan run command executes the scan test.
The worktree of athena/records is created or located under Athena's state directory via the path in paths.rs; fallback to in-tree records/ applies only when it is absent.
I did not re-open the repository; the file list derives from the earlier failed plan's inventory and the request's Files line, and the implementer must re-enumerate call sites by search.

acceptance_criteria.text: A test puts different records in the worktree and in the in-tree records/ and checks that each moved reader (Records::load_current, RecordSet::load_current, read_records, xtask walltime, status, auditor, reading, scope_guard, run, manage, proposals, audience, review, hestia, steward, code_health, work_decisions, backtest, drain) returns the worktree's records. Run cargo test --locked.

With no worktree present, each moved reader falls back to records/ and returns the same result as before. athena status and a forecast succeed on a scratch checkout whose working tree has no records/, reading only the worktree, with output matching the records/ run. Run cargo test --locked.
The worktree path is defined once, in crates/athena-data/src/paths.rs next to repo_state_dir. No non-test reader joins records/ itself outside paths.rs and the fallback.

An xtask scan test named records_reader_scan fails on a planted direct read of records/ in non-test code and passes on the real tree. It matches reader shapes (join("records"), read_records(<repo dir>), Records/RecordSet::load() only, so citation strings in steward.rs and work_decisions.rs and the gate invariant.rs BOOTSTRAP_OUTCOME path are not flagged. Run cargo test -p xtask --locked records_reader_scan, and confirm it executes (nonzero tests run).

The study site generator is unchanged: xtask/src/site.rs is untouched and not rooted at the worktree, and its output is identical when built with records/ present and with it absent. Run cargo run -p xtask -- site both ways and compare outputs.
cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy --all-targets and the full cargo test --locked pass, including existing tests unchanged before the branch exists.
docs/decisions.md and CHANGELOG.md record the reader move, the fallback, and that the site generator is out of scope, citing D111.

out_of_scope: Rerooting the study site generator (xtask/src/site.rs), which reads studies/firstmate-work-handling
Creating or populating the athena/records branch
Flagging citation strings such as 'records/jobs' labels in steward.rs and work_decisions.rs
departures: Sweeping change across ~30 files with a new scan test and a worktree fallback; costlier and slower than the reference median, and the earlier attempt failed in planning.
urgent_reason: Retrying a job that failed in planning cuts wasted time from a rejected attempt and redo work by listing every touched file and settling the site generator scope up front.
